samples.question: The two gray cards at the top are the LEFT and RIGHT reference sets. Black four-square glyphs count as the same when one can be quarter-turned to match the other; mirror images do not count. Each tagged card below has a left column and a right column, with order within a column irrelevant. Which color tags the only card whose left column contains exactly the LEFT set and whose right column contains exactly the RIGHT set? Answer amber, cyan, or violet.
